note: 单元通关专属迷你阅读(运动主题,独立短文,不在阅读关出现)。短文2-3句+2题,答案转述非照抄,2题覆盖不同位置。

finalReading.passage: Hana had always been the slowest runner in her class, and other children often laughed at her. Instead of giving up, she got up early every morning to train, encouraged by her older brother. A year later, she surprised everyone by winning the school race, proud of how far her quiet effort had taken her.

questions.q: What did Hana do instead of giving up?
options: She trained early every morning with her brother's support.
She laughed at the other children.
She changed to a different school.
questions.explanation: 原文 'got up early every morning to train, encouraged by her older brother' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: How did Hana feel a year later?
options: Proud of what her effort had achieved.
questions.explanation: 末句 'proud of how far her quiet effort had taken her'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。
